title: Majority of the Bests: Improving Best-of-N via Bootstrapping
authors_zh: Amin Rakhsha、Kanika Madan、Tianyu Zhang、Amir-massoud Farahmand、Amir Khasahmadi
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: MoB estimates the modal answer of a reward-ranked Best-of-m distribution from a fixed completion pool and releases prompts, generations, extracted answers, correctness scores, and reward scores for offline selection studies.
MoB 从固定的候选池中估计奖励排序后 Best-of-m 分布的众数答案，并发布提示、生成结果、抽取答案、正确性与奖励分数以支持离线选择研究。
why: It exposes a reusable test-time selection object for Track 5 and separates generation budget, reward ranking, answer aggregation, and final benchmark correctness, while provenance and data-rights questions remain.
inclusion_reason: Releases scored completion pools and a closed-form reward-model bootstrap selector for studying how test-time output aggregation changes with sampling budget.

title: Problem
问题
html: Best-of-N (BoN) spends test-time compute by sampling N outputs, scoring each with a reward model, and returning the highest-scoring output. With an imperfect reward model, that selected answer remains stochastic: the correct answer may be the most probable outcome of repeated BoN runs without being chosen reliably in any one run. Majority-of-the-Bests (MoB) asks whether the mode of this reward-ranked answer distribution is a better decision than one maximum-reward sample. For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data category, the relevant object is the complete output pool together with extracted discrete answers, scalar reward scores, resampling budget, estimated selection distribution, and final chosen answer. The official release makes much of this pool-level object available rather than publishing only aggregate benchmark scores.

Best-of-N 通过生成 N 个输出、用 reward model 评分并返回最高分回答来使用测试时计算；当 reward model 不完美，同一问题多次运行 BoN 的选中答案仍会变化。Majority-of-the-Bests 研究能否返回这一“最高奖励答案分布”的众数，而不是信任单次最高分样本。对本项目而言，关键数据对象是完整候选池、离散最终答案、标量 reward、重采样预算、估计的选择分布和最终决定。官方发布包含池级记录，而不只有 benchmark 汇总分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Given N generated outputs and their scalar rewards, MoB considers Best-of-m on bootstrap samples of size m<N drawn with replacement from the same pool. Each bootstrap sample contributes the final-answer value of its highest-reward output; MoB returns the most frequent such answer, approximating the mode of the Best-of-m output distribution. The released implementation does not materialize thousands of bootstrap subsets. After sorting outputs by reward, it computes in closed form the probability that each output would be the maximum in an m-sample, sums those probabilities by extracted final answer, and chooses the answer with the largest mass in O(N log N). The feedback contract is therefore learned scalar judgment plus exact grouping by final-answer string; the reward model ranks whole completions, while majority aggregation operates on extracted answers.

给定 N 个输出及其标量奖励，MoB 考察从同一池中有放回抽取 m 个样本时的 Best-of-m 结果，并返回这些最高奖励样本最终答案的众数。实际实现不保存大量 bootstrap 子集，而是在按 reward 排序后闭式计算每个输出成为 m 次抽样最大值的概率，再按抽取后的最终答案聚合概率质量，以 O(N log N) 选取质量最大的答案。反馈契约由学习得到的整段回答标量评分与精确答案分组共同组成；reward model 排序 completion，众数聚合发生在最终答案层。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper evaluates five 500-question benchmark slices: MATH500, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro-Math, MMLU-Pro-Chem, and CommonsenseQA. It generates 512 outputs per question at temperature 1 with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, or Gemma-2-9B-it, then scores them with ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 and GRM-Llama3.2-3B-rewardmodel-ft. Language Model Evaluation Harness performs final-answer extraction and correctness evaluation. Main tables use N=128; for each budget N, the evaluation takes floor(512/N) disjoint slices from the cached pool. The paper studies fixed m=floor(sqrt(N)) and an adaptive rule that compares closed-form answer distributions for candidates floor(q^j N) with q=0.75. Selection runs on CPU and does not train the generator or reward model.

The official Git LFS release is organized by benchmark and generator. A checked JSONL record contains doc_id, the full prompt, the full generation, binary generation_score, extracted generation_final_answer, and a rewards dictionary with grm3b, armorm, and skywork values. The runner groups records by doc_id, forms arrays of final answers, rewards, and correctness scores, and can save per-problem decisions. Pools contain up to 512 outputs per question; the README exposes budgets up to 512 and scripts for BoN, self-consistency, Weighted BoN, and both MoB variants.

The release also lists a MATH500 GPT-4o-mini pool. It is an additional cached artifact rather than one of the three main open-generator settings described above, so its provenance and use should be tracked separately.

论文评测 MATH500、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro-Math、MMLU-Pro-Chem 和 CommonsenseQA 各 500 题切片。每题以温度 1 从 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 或 Gemma-2-9B-it 生成 512 个输出，再用 ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 和 GRM-Llama3.2-3B reward model 评分。主表使用 N=128；对每个预算 N，从缓存池取 floor(512/N) 个互不重叠切片。论文比较固定 m=floor(sqrt(N)) 与自适应规则，后者考察 floor(q^j N)，q=0.75。官方 Git LFS 数据按 benchmark/generator 组织，记录包含 doc_id、完整 prompt、generation、generation_score、抽取答案和 GRM/ArmoRM/Skywork rewards；runner 按 doc_id 分组并可保存逐题决定。选择阶段只在 CPU 上运行，不训练 generator 或 reward model。

发布清单还列出一个 MATH500 GPT-4o-mini 候选池。它是额外缓存 artifact，并非上述三个主要开源 generator 设置之一，因此其来源和使用范围应单独记录。

title: Evidence
证据
html: At N=128 with Qwen2.5-3B and GRM, Table 1 reports that adaptive MoB exceeds BoN on four of five benchmark slices: MATH500 69.95 versus 63.95, MMLU-Pro-Math 69.30 versus 66.10, MMLU-Pro-Chem 56.45 versus 49.00, and GSM8K 82.85 versus 80.95; on CommonsenseQA it is lower, 77.40 versus 77.70. Across the paper's 30 generator/reward/benchmark settings, the authors report improvement over BoN in 25. These results support the narrower claim that modal aggregation can improve final-answer selection under the tested pools and reward models; they do not show that every completion, reward, or extracted answer is high quality. The theory proves consistency of the m-out-of-N bootstrap estimate under finite answer support, reward-tail assumptions, m tending to infinity, and m/N tending to zero. The code and scored pools are released, making offline selector comparisons auditable, but benchmark gains are not evidence of data rights, decontamination, or reward-label validity.

在 N=128、Qwen2.5-3B 与 GRM 设置下，Table 1 中 adaptive MoB 相对 BoN 的结果为：MATH500 69.95 对 63.95，MMLU-Pro-Math 69.30 对 66.10，MMLU-Pro-Chem 56.45 对 49.00，GSM8K 82.85 对 80.95；CommonsenseQA 则为 77.40 对 77.70，没有提高。作者在 30 个 generator/reward/benchmark 组合中报告 25 个优于 BoN。这只支持“指定候选池与 reward 下，众数聚合可能改善选择”的有限结论，不能证明 completion、reward 或抽取答案质量可靠。理论一致性还要求有限答案支持、reward-tail 假设、m 趋于无穷且 m/N 趋于零。代码和评分池使离线审计可行，但 benchmark 提升不是数据权利、去污染或 reward-label 有效性的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: MoB does not generate a new reasoning path, train a verifier, or ask the reward model for a different kind of score. Its contribution is a selection transformation over the same N outputs and scalar rewards used by BoN: estimate the Best-of-m answer distribution and return its mode. Relative to self-consistency, it preserves reward ranking within each hypothetical subset; relative to BoN, it aggregates the distribution of maximum-reward outcomes instead of trusting one maximum; relative to Weighted BoN, it does not simply sum raw rewards by answer. The closed-form O(N log N) implementation and adaptive m rule make this transformation practical. For the atlas, the novelty lies in the reusable selector and released scored-pool schema, not in claiming that reward-model scores are ground truth or that a modal answer is intrinsically better reasoning.

MoB 不生成新的推理路径，也不训练新的 verifier；它只变换 BoN 已有的 N 个输出与标量 reward：估计 Best-of-m 答案分布并返回其众数。相对 self-consistency，它保留每个假想子集内的 reward 排序；相对 BoN，它聚合最高 reward 结果的分布；相对 Weighted BoN，它不是简单按答案累加原始 reward。对本图谱而言，可复用贡献是闭式 O(N log N) selector、adaptive m 规则和发布的评分候选池 schema，而不是把众数答案视为更优推理的天然证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html: MoB requires a finite set of comparable discrete final answers. Answer extraction and normalization can split semantically equivalent answers or merge distinct ones, directly changing the mode. Its main assumption can also fail: when the mode of the reward-ranked Best-of-m distribution is wrong, MoB chooses that wrong answer more deterministically, whereas a stochastic Best-of-m draw can still be correct by chance. Reward misranking, reward hacking, calibration differences, and ties therefore remain central risks. Conventional m=N bootstrap is inconsistent for a maximum statistic; the theory instead requires m-out-of-N conditions that are asymptotic and include reward-tail assumptions. Generation still costs N model calls per question, and the paper estimates a few thousand H100 GPU-hours for the pools without tracking exact compute. The release provides prompts, completions, extracted answers, correctness, and reward scores, but no decontamination report or random question-selection seed. Its top-level MIT license does not separately resolve upstream benchmark rights, model-output terms, or reward-annotation rights.

MoB 需要有限且可比较的离散答案；答案抽取或规范化会直接改变众数。如果 reward 排序后的 Best-of-m 分布众数错误，MoB 会更稳定地返回错误答案。reward 误排、reward hacking、校准差异和 tie handling 均是核心风险。常规 m=N bootstrap 对最大值统计量并不一致；论文依赖 m-out-of-N 的渐近条件与 reward-tail 假设。生成仍需每题 N 次模型调用，论文估计候选池消耗数千 H100 GPU-hours，但没有精确追踪 compute。发布物没有去污染报告或随机题目 seed；顶层 MIT 许可也不能自动解决上游 benchmark、模型输出和 reward 标注权利。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, this release supports controlled offline comparison of selection rules without regenerating outputs. A reusable record should retain the benchmark and doc_id, exact prompt, generator and decoding settings, all candidate completions, extracted-answer normalization, benchmark correctness, reward-model identity and version, raw scalar rewards, selected budget N, subsample size m or adaptive rule, estimated answer masses, tie handling, selected candidate index, and final answer. Keeping generation_score separate from reward scores prevents benchmark correctness from being mistaken for the online selection signal. The pools can be used to audit BoN, self-consistency, Weighted BoN, and MoB under equal candidate budgets, study selector sensitivity to reward models, or prototype stopping rules. Reuse should remain conditional on upstream licenses, contamination checks, and the fixed-pool nature of the release.

该发布可在不重新生成输出的情况下，用相同候选预算比较 BoN、self-consistency、Weighted BoN 与 MoB，并分析 selector 对 reward model 的敏感性或试验停止规则。可复用记录应保存 benchmark/doc_id、完整 prompt、generator 与解码设置、所有 completion、答案规范化、benchmark correctness、reward model 身份与版本、原始标量 reward、预算 N、m 或 adaptive rule、估计答案概率质量、tie 处理、选中索引和最终答案。generation_score 必须与 reward 分开，避免把 benchmark correctness 当成在线选择信号；复用仍取决于上游许可、污染检查与固定池边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• MoB reuses one N-output pool; it changes selection, not generation or model weights.
  • The actual implementation computes the bootstrap answer distribution in closed form rather than storing sampled subsets.
  • Released JSONL records include prompt, full generation, extracted answer, benchmark score, and ArmoRM/GRM/Skywork rewards.
  • The main tables use N=128; generation pools contain 512 temperature-1 outputs per question.
  • Gains over BoN evaluate a selector and do not prove completion quality, reward validity, decontamination, or data rights.

• MoB 复用同一个 N-output pool；它改变 selection，不改变 generation 或模型权重。
  • 实现闭式计算 bootstrap 答案分布，不保存实际抽样子集。
  • 发布 JSONL 包含 prompt、完整 generation、抽取答案、benchmark score 以及 ArmoRM/GRM/Skywork reward。
  • 主表使用 N=128；候选池每题最多含 512 个温度为 1 的输出。
  • 相对 BoN 的增益只评估 selector，不能证明 completion 质量、reward 有效性、去污染或数据权利。
